constrained: a_Sigma=1 and the stored scalar-wall junction traces
fixed: topology, Z2 gluing, and normal orientation
freely_varied: bulk metric and independent intrinsic metric before matching
bulk radial shift in the interior as a constraint multiplier
gauge: radial coordinate displacement zeta used to represent the fixed support
physically_dynamical: intrinsic B1 metric/connection/scalar sectors in their declared domain
boundary_data.radion_status: not established: zeta is not an independent action variable, while S_Sigma is gauge invariant but lacks boundary-domain data
unspecified: a variational rule for x-dependent embedding deformations

first_variation.condition_classification: absent because embedding/threading data are not varied
first_variation.embedding_variation: absent; if it were declared, tangential displacement gives the Codazzi/Ward momentum balance and normal displacement gives a shape equation, neither present in the frozen variational domain
first_variation.longitudinal_classification: Codazzi/Bianchi Ward identity after the bulk momentum constraint; not an independent endpoint-domain equation for S_Sigma
first_variation.matching: vary independent g,h,Lambda; impose h=iota^*g; eliminate Lambda
first_variation.reason_no_shift_endpoint_term: the ADM shift enters K_mu_nu through tangential derivatives and has no radial derivative; at fixed embedding gamma_mu_nu=h_mu_nu, so GHY, B1, scalar Dirichlet data, and S_match contain no independent delta S_Sigma
first_variation.scalar_endpoint_term: -Z5 integral_Sigma sqrt|gamma| (n sigma)delta sigma; the wall problem fixes delta sigma_Sigma=0

gauge.convention: delta g -> delta g-L_xi g, xi^A=(xi^rho,D^mu xi), rho_Sigma=rho_J+zeta
gauge.delta_X_intrinsic_proof: radial xi^rho terms cancel in the pullback; an M4 scalar diffeomorphism acts only by the Lie derivative of background X, which vanishes for the homogeneous constant-X fold
gauge.fixed_endpoint_gauge: zeta=0 may be chosen with xi^rho|Sigma=-zeta
gauge.longitudinal_gauge: E=0 may be chosen with xi=E
gauge.residual_classification: S_Sigma is unchanged by both choices and by their residual transformations; an undetermined S_Sigma trace is not residual gauge

pullback.bulk_ADM_metric: ds5^2=N^2 d rho^2+h_mu_nu(dx^mu+N^mu d rho)(dx^nu+N^nu d rho)
pullback.induced_metric_exact: gamma_mu_nu=[h_mu_nu+N_mu D_nu zeta+N_nu D_mu zeta+(N^2+N_alpha N^alpha)D_mu zeta D_nu zeta]_Sigma
pullback.lapse_normal_exact: N_Sigma=[N^-2+2N^mu D_mu zeta/N^2+(h^mu_nu+N^mu N^nu/N^2)D_mu zeta D_nu zeta]^-1/2
pullback.unit_normal_linear: n_A=(N,-N D_mu zeta); n^mu=-(N^mu+N^2 D^mu zeta)/N

repository_domain.B1_geometry: a provisional codimension-one intrinsic M4 boundary/interface; the Z2 construction uses y=0 and glues two regular caps
repository_domain.B1_support_in_frozen_action: fixed boundary domain and fixed embedding iota
repository_domain.metric_ontology: independent intrinsic h_mu_nu with exact multiplier constraint h_mu_nu=iota^*g_mu_nu
repository_domain.rho_J_static_status: cap length/junction position solved by the homogeneous boundary-value problem; not promoted to an x-dependent embedding field
repository_domain.static_transversality: v6.1.7 includes the one-dimensional moving-upper-limit/domain shape response along the homogeneous cap family
repository_domain.v6_11_moving_endpoint: proper-normal coordinate representation of the same solved domain; fixed-domain and moving-coordinate descriptions agree after matching endpoint data
